title: colorpickerframe
summary: Current Benilla's ColorPickerFrame is chiefly an addon/Lua API contract: ColorSelect methods and named globals, caller-installed func/opacityFunc/cancelFunc callbacks, previousValues restoration, live color/opacity callbacks, UISpecialFrames Escape behavior, and 305/365-width geometry. MSUI has no addon Lua VM or dropdown-swatch consumer, so adding an unowned native color modal would create visible furniture with no truthful caller contract. No implementation was added during this pass.

openItems.text: If MSUI gains addon/Lua compatibility, implement ColorPickerFrame as one rule-owned centered 305x200 or 365x200 modal with exact named methods/fields, HSV color selection, 32x32 swatch, optional 16x128 opacity slider, live callbacks, Okay/Cancel ordering, previousValues restoration and Escape cancellation. Until a consumer exists, do not add a disconnected ImGui color editor and call it parity.
